GraphScaleStrings.title: Show graph scale
MediaImageConverterStrings.tooLarge: These dimensions are too large to process safely. Choose a smaller size.
NotchLowBatteryStrings.caption: Shows the charge in red at or below this level while on battery.
NotchLowBatteryStrings.earlyCaption: Shows the charge in amber at or below a higher level, as an early warning.
NotchLowBatteryStrings.title: Turn red when low
PointerDisplayStrings.caption: Puts the pointer in the center of the next display.
PointerDisplayStrings.title: Move pointer to next display
ShelfPromiseDeliveryStrings.failedBody: The file never finished saving to the shelf.
ShelfPromiseDeliveryStrings.fullBody: The attachment finished saving but there is no room left on the shelf.
Strings.aboutDescription:
A utility hub for your Mac.
Energy, system monitor, scrolling and a window switcher, right in the menu bar.
Strings.adminPromptClamshellOff: Vorssaint needs your password to restore the Mac’s normal sleep.
Strings.adminPromptClamshellOn: Vorssaint needs your password to keep the Mac going with the lid closed.
Strings.adminPromptRecover: Vorssaint quit while the Mac’s sleep was disabled. Enter the password to restore normal sleep.
Strings.adminPromptSudoersInstall: Vorssaint will create a restricted rule (pmset disablesleep only) to toggle closed-lid mode without asking for a password. This is the only time the password is needed.
Strings.adminPromptSudoersRemove: Vorssaint will remove the password-free closed-lid rule.
Strings.adminPromptUpdate: Vorssaint needs your password to install the update.
Strings.advancedClearConfirmBody: Features that need permissions will stop working until you grant them again. Your settings are kept.
Strings.advancedClearFailed: Some permissions or the closed-lid rule could not be removed. Try again and allow the password request if it appears.
Strings.advancedResetDescription: Removes every permission you granted Vorssaint (Accessibility, Screen Recording, Full Disk Access and others), the login item and the closed-lid rule. Useful to start fresh or before uninstalling. The app stays installed.
Strings.advancedUninstallConfirmBody: Vorssaint will clear its permissions, remove its preferences and move to the Trash, then quit. This can’t be undone from the app, but it stays in the Trash until you empty it.
Strings.advancedUninstallDescription: Does all of the above, then removes the preferences and moves Vorssaint to the Trash, leaving nothing behind. The app quits when done. You can reinstall anytime.
Strings.advancedUninstallFailedBody: Vorssaint could not put back a system setting it changed: sleep, fan speed, mouse acceleration or Space order. Nothing was removed. Try again and allow the password request if it appears.
Strings.audioPriorityCaption: Devices are selected in priority order. When a higher-priority device connects, it becomes active. When the active one disconnects, the next available takes over.
Strings.audioPriorityInputEnable: Automatically switch to the highest-priority microphone
Strings.audioPriorityOutputEnable: Automatically switch to the highest-priority output
Strings.autoQuitEnable: Quit an app when its last window closes
Strings.autoQuitEnableCaption: Closing an app’s last window also quits it.
Strings.autoQuitExceptionsCaption: Apps on this list stay open even with no windows.
Strings.autoQuitOngoingWorkNote: Some apps close their last window while they keep working, such as a screen recorder once capture starts. Those are quit too, unless they are on the Exceptions list.
Strings.autoQuitPredictableNote: Apps that normally run without a window are never quit.
Strings.autoQuitStep1: Close an app’s last window (⌘W or the red button).
Strings.autoQuitStep2: The app quits on its own. “Save changes?” dialogs still appear.
Strings.batteryProtectionCaption: Keeps a forgotten session from draining the MacBook battery.
Strings.betaFeatureWarning: Beta. You may run into some bugs.
Strings.clamshellExplanation: “Keep going with the lid closed” fully disables sleep while “Keep awake” is active and is reverted automatically when the session ends or the app quits. Prefer using it plugged in.
Strings.clamshellNeedsPassword: Will ask for the administrator password once
Strings.clamshellOnCaption: Sleep fully disabled. Mind the power
Strings.clamshellTitle: Keep going with the lid closed
Strings.cleanerAutoNotificationFormat: %@ freed and sent to the Trash.
Strings.cleanerCachesCaption: Temporary files apps rebuild on their own.
Strings.cleanerDeviceBackupsCaption: Old iPhone and iPad backups take a big slice of the storage macOS calls Other. Remove only the ones you no longer need; a new backup is made when you plug the device in again.
Strings.cleanerDoneNote: Items went to the Trash and can be recovered from there.
Strings.cleanerIntroCaption: Scans for leftovers from uninstalled apps, caches, logs and the Trash. You review everything first and removed items go to the Trash.
Strings.cleanerLeftoversCaption: Files left behind by apps you uninstalled.
Strings.cleanerLeftoversNote: Found by analysis and left unchecked. Check the path before ticking.
Strings.cleanerLoginItemsCaption: Startup entries left by apps that no longer exist.
Strings.cleanerLoginItemsNote: The entry under Login Items disappears after restarting the Mac.
Strings.cleanerNothingFound: Nothing to clean. Your Mac is tidy.
Strings.cleanerNotifDenied: Vorssaint notifications are turned off in the system.
Strings.cleanerOtherCachesCaption: Safe to remove, nothing breaks. Apps may open slower once and downloaded content, like offline music, downloads again.
Strings.cleanerScheduleCaption: Cleans only the safe part on its own at the chosen time and sends everything to the Trash.
Strings.cleanerScreenshotsCaptionFormat: Screenshots you have not opened in %d days that still have the name and folder macOS gave them. Ones you renamed or moved never show up here.
Strings.cleanerScreenshotsSettingCaption: The scan lists the screenshots you have not opened for this long, unchecked, with their total size.
Strings.cleaningKeepScreenVisibleCaption: Shows a discreet indicator in the corner of the screen instead of blacking out content.
Strings.cleaningNeedsAxBody: To lock the keyboard safely, Vorssaint needs Accessibility permission. Grant it in System Settings and try again.
Strings.cleaningOverlayMouseHint: Your mouse and trackpad still work
Strings.cleaningPanelCaption: Locks the keyboard so you can clean safely.
Strings.colorPickerCaption: Grab the color of any pixel on screen and copy it in your favorite format.
Strings.communityIntroMessage: People who already followed me on X saw several changes in this update before anyone else. I post previews of what is coming and show how it works, so you already know the basics before the update ships. Follow along and see what comes next!
Strings.cutPasteAutomationNote: The first time, macOS asks for permission to control Finder.
Strings.cutPasteEnableCaption: Use ⌘X to cut and ⌘V to move files and folders in Finder.
Strings.cutPasteShowHUDCaption: Display a floating indicator with the cut files while Finder is active.
Strings.cutPasteStep1: Select items in Finder and press ⌘X to cut them.
Strings.cutPasteStep2: Open the destination folder and press ⌘V to move them there.
Strings.cutPasteTextNote: In text fields (like when renaming), ⌘X and ⌘V keep working as usual.
Strings.cutReadyHint: in the destination folder to move
Strings.dimScreenOnLidCloseCaption: Dims the display when the lid closes and brings the brightness back when it opens.
Strings.discordIntroMessage: The Vorssaint community is new and still being built. Join early to meet other users and help build a welcoming space around the app.
Strings.discordIntroTitle: The Vorssaint Discord community is just getting started
Strings.diskNoExternal: No external disk ready to eject.
Strings.dockClickCycleWindows: Click the Dock icon to cycle windows
Strings.dockClickCycleWindowsCaption: Click an active app’s Dock icon to rotate through its windows, like ⌘`.
Strings.dockClickHide: Click the Dock icon to hide the app
Strings.dockClickHideCaption: The active app hides when you click its Dock icon. Click again to bring it back.
Strings.dockClickMinimize: Click the Dock icon to minimize
Strings.dockClickMinimizeCaption: The active app’s windows minimize when you click its Dock icon. Click again to bring them back.
Strings.dockPreviewAutohideBeta: Beta. You may run into some bugs.
Strings.dockPreviewBackgroundOpacityCapt: Turn it down to see more of what sits behind the panel.
Strings.dockPreviewBackgroundOpacityGlas: Liquid Glass is on, so the panel’s transparency is set in System Settings > Appearance.
Strings.dockPreviewCurrentSpaceOnlyCapti: When off, shows windows from all desktops. Choosing a window on another desktop takes you there.
Strings.dockPreviewEnableCaption: Hover over an open app in the Dock to see its windows, then click the one you want.
Strings.dockPreviewKeepDockVisibleCaptio: Pauses auto-hide while the preview is open and restores it when you leave. May resize windows. If the app is interrupted, reopen it to restore the Dock.
Strings.dockPreviewOpenDelayCaption: How long the pointer has to rest on an icon before its panel opens.
Strings.dockPreviewOrderByCreationCaptio: Show older windows first instead of the ones you used most recently.
Strings.dockPreviewQuitAppOnClose: Quit the app with the × button
Strings.dockPreviewQuitAppOnCloseCaption: In Dock Preview, × quits the whole app instead of closing only that window.
Strings.donateButton: Support on Buy Me a Coffee
Strings.donateMessage: Vorssaint is free, independent and built in my spare time. If you would like to contribute financially, Buy Me a Coffee directly helps me keep development moving forward.
Strings.extraBrightnessCaption: Uses the display’s HDR headroom to go past the maximum brightness. Uses more battery and the Mac can run warm.
Strings.extraBrightnessUnsupported: Available only on XDR displays, such as the ones on the 14 and 16 inch MacBook Pro.
Strings.focusFollowsMouseCaption: Focuses the window under the pointer.
Strings.focusFollowsMouseRaise: Bring the window to the front
Strings.focusFollowsMouseWaitForStop: Wait for the pointer to stop
Strings.highlightsCaptionCapturePalette: One shortcut now opens a floating palette for screenshots, recordings, screen text and colors with nearby controls.
Strings.highlightsCaptionClipboardRedesi: Clipboard history now opens as a compact palette with uncluttered rows and an on-demand preview for reading or editing the full item.
Strings.highlightsCaptionDockPreview: Dock Preview now works with Dock magnification turned on
Strings.highlightsCaptionQuitProtection: Avoid quitting apps or closing windows by accident with a hold, a double press or an extra modifier, customizable per app.
Strings.highlightsCaptionRecorderBlur: Hide private details, passwords and sensitive areas anywhere across your recorded video before sharing or exporting.
Strings.highlightsCaptionScreenshot: The screenshot tool gained a pixel loupe and QR code reading
Strings.highlightsCaptionSnippetLibrary: A searchable snippet menu types any snippet right at your cursor
Strings.highlightsCaptionWindowLayout: Position windows with the directional ring using a shortcut and pointer, or drag to screen edges to snap with custom gaps.
Strings.homebrewConfirmInstallBodyFormat: Homebrew will download and install %@. Dependencies may also be installed.
Strings.homebrewConfirmUninstallBodyForm: Homebrew will uninstall %@. Configuration files may remain on the system.
Strings.homebrewConfirmUpdateHomebrewBod: Homebrew will fetch the latest information and then reload your packages.
Strings.homebrewConfirmUpgradeAllBody: Homebrew will download and apply the latest versions for packages with updates available. Dependencies may also be updated.
Strings.homebrewConfirmUpgradeBodyFormat: Homebrew will download and apply the latest version of %@. Dependencies may also be updated.
Strings.homebrewEnableCaption: Search, install and remove formulae and casks.
Strings.homebrewInstallHomebrewCaption: When Terminal finishes, come back here and click Refresh.
Strings.homebrewKeyboardHint: Space or Return closes the macOS panel. Use the search button.
Strings.homebrewMissingBody: Vorssaint can open Terminal with the official Homebrew installer. Terminal shows the steps and asks for your password if needed.
Strings.homebrewNoSelection: Select an installed package or search for a new one.
Strings.homebrewOfficialIntroMessage: Vorssaint can now be installed directly from the official Homebrew catalog.
Strings.homebrewOfficialIntroMigrationMe: Remove the tap once. The app and your settings stay in place.
Strings.homebrewOfficialIntroTitle: Now in the official Homebrew catalog
Strings.homebrewOperationProgressUnknown: Homebrew has not reported a percentage yet.
Strings.homebrewOrphansNote: Installed as dependencies, but no installed package needs them any more.
Strings.homebrewShellSetupBody: Homebrew is installed, but Terminal may not find the brew command yet. Vorssaint can open Terminal with the setup command.
Strings.homebrewShellSetupOpened: Command opened in Terminal. Then come back here and click Refresh.
Strings.homebrewTerminalFallback: This operation needs Terminal to ask for the administrator password. Vorssaint does not capture passwords.
Strings.homebrewTrustCaption: Homebrew now asks for your confirmation before using third party taps. Trust %@ to continue.
Strings.hotkeyCaption: Works in any app, no extra permissions.
Strings.includeBetaUpdatesCaption: Beta versions include features in development and may contain bugs or incomplete behavior.
Strings.keepAwakeAutoStartCaption: Starts a session with the default duration.
Strings.keepAwakeMouseJiggleCaption: During a session, moves the pointer a little at the chosen interval.
Strings.keepAwakeNormalRules: The Mac follows its normal energy rules
Strings.keepAwakeRightClickToggle: Right-click the menu bar icon to toggle Keep Awake
Strings.keepAwakeUntilDisabled: Active until you turn it off
Strings.keyDebounceCaption: Filters very fast duplicate key presses.
Strings.keyDebouncePerKeyCaption: Per-key values override the global window. Use 0 ms to stop filtering a key.
Strings.launchAtLoginNeedsApplications: The app is running from a place that cannot open at login. Drag Vorssaint to the Applications folder, open it from there and turn this on again.
Strings.launchAtLoginNeedsApproval: The login item is registered, but macOS still needs your approval. In System Settings, allow Vorssaint to open at login and to run in the background.
Strings.launcherCaption: A floating panel with your favorite tools, summoned by a shortcut from anywhere.
Strings.launcherEditHint: Use the tune button to choose, hide and drag the tools around.
Strings.launcherEmptyState: All tools are hidden. Use the tune button to add them back.
Strings.launcherKeysHint: Arrows navigate, Enter opens, 1 to 9 open directly
Strings.linearScrollCaption: Every notch of the mouse wheel scrolls the same distance, no matter how fast it spins. The trackpad is not affected.
Strings.mediaDropHint: Drop a file here or click to choose one.
Strings.mediaEnableCaption: Compress videos, convert and process images, make GIFs and extract text locally.
Strings.mediaErrorNoVideo: This file has no video track.
Strings.mediaErrorSameOutput: Choose a destination different from the original file.
Strings.mediaErrorTargetTooSmall: Target size too small for this clip. Trim it or raise the limit.
Strings.mediaResultGrewCaption: The converted file came out larger than the original.
Strings.mediaTargetSizeHint: Resolution adapts to stay under the limit.
Strings.mediaTextOutputNote: Extracted text can be copied and saved as TXT.
Strings.menuBarHideIconCaption: The icon returns by itself when metrics leave the bar and when there is something to signal (an update ready, “Keep awake” running or the microphone muted).
Strings.menuBarHideIconToggle: Hide the app icon while metrics are shown
Strings.menuBarIconDisallowedBody: macOS is keeping Vorssaint out of the menu bar. Open System Settings > Menu Bar, find Vorssaint in the app list and turn on “Allow in the Menu Bar”. The icon appears as soon as the switch is on.
Strings.menuBarIconManagerHintFormat: %@ is open and may be keeping the icon in its hidden section. Look for Vorssaint there, or set %@ to always show Vorssaint.
Strings.menuBarIconStillHiddenBody: The icon was rebuilt, but macOS did not give it a visible spot. The menu bar is probably out of room: remove some menu bar icons (or close apps with long menus) and try again.
Strings.micMuteCaption: Cuts the Mac’s microphone with a click or shortcut, across every app.
Strings.micMuteMenuBarCaption: A red crossed-out mic appears beside the app’s icon in the menu bar while this feature mutes it.
Strings.micMuteMenuBarToggle: Show in the menu bar while muted
Strings.micMutePartialHUD: Some microphones could not be muted
Strings.middleClickDragConflict: macOS three-finger drag is turned on and uses three fingers, so click with four fingers for the middle click. To use three, turn three-finger drag off in System Settings under Accessibility, Pointer Control, Trackpad Options.
Strings.middleClickEnable: Three-finger click acts as middle click
Strings.middleClickEnableCaption: Pressing the trackpad with three fingers works like a mouse wheel click: open links in a new tab, close tabs and everything else the middle button does.
Strings.middleClickNoTrackpad: Can’t read trackpad touches. Connect a supported trackpad.
Strings.middleClickTapCaption: A light tap with that many fingers, without pressing, also fires the middle click. Sliding never counts. If the macOS three-finger tap is assigned to Look Up, turn it off so both do not fire together.
Strings.minimalWindowPreviewsCaption: Hide titles, buttons and decorative details in Dock and switcher previews. The selection stays visible.
Strings.mixerBypassedCaption: This app manages its own audio.
Strings.mixerEmpty: Apps that use audio show up here
Strings.mixerInputFallback: Using default until this microphone returns.
Strings.mixerLowerOnHeadphonesDisconnect: Adjusts output when wired or Bluetooth headphones disconnect.
Strings.mixerOutputFallback: Using default until this device returns.
Strings.mixerPermissionBody: To adjust per-app volume, allow “Screen & System Audio Recording” in System Settings. Audio is never recorded.
Strings.mixerSoundEffectsOutputTooltip: Choose where alerts and sound effects play
Strings.monitorCombineTemperaturesCaptio: When usage and temperature for the same item are enabled, show them in one block.
Strings.monitorMenuBarCaption: Choose what appears next to the icon in the menu bar.
Strings.monitorOrderHint: Drag to reorder the panel sections and use the eye to show or hide each one.
Strings.monitorPanelConfigHint: Open a block to choose what it shows.
Strings.monitorSeparateMenuBarMetrics: Separate metrics into their own items
Strings.monitorSeparateMenuBarMetricsCap: Separates active blocks in the menu bar and keeps usage and temperature together when combine is on.
Strings.mouseAccelerationCaption: Removes pointer acceleration for connected mice. Your previous setting returns when this is turned off or Vorssaint quits.
Strings.mouseNavigationCaption: Turns the mouse Back and Forward buttons into navigation commands in Finder, browsers and compatible apps.
Strings.mouseNavigationEnable: Use side buttons for Back and Forward
Strings.musicBlockCaption: Blocks the music app opening after a detected media key. Requires Accessibility access. Headphone commands without a detected key are left alone.
Strings.musicBlockReplacementBlocked: Music and iTunes are the apps being blocked, so they can’t open instead. Choose another app.
Strings.musicBlockTitle: Stop Music from opening on its own
Strings.musicBlockUnavailable: This protection is unavailable right now. Turn it off and on to try again.
Strings.notifyBatteryBody: Low battery. Normal sleep was restored to protect the charge.
Strings.notifySessionEndedBody: Time is up. The Mac will sleep normally again.
Strings.obAccessibilityWhy: The app only watches the mouse wheel and the switcher shortcut. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Strings.obDoneHint: Look for the black hole in the menu bar, at the top right of the screen.
Strings.obLanguageUpdateBody: Vorssaint now speaks several languages. Choose the one you’d like to use; you can change it anytime in Settings.
Strings.obMonitorNoPermission: No permission needed. Sensors are read straight from the system.
Strings.obPurposeBody: Choose a ready setup or select exactly what you want to use.
Strings.obPurposeSkip: You can add or remove features later in Settings.
Strings.obRecordingWhy: Thumbnails are generated on the fly, stay in memory and never leave your Mac. Without it, the switcher still works with icons.
Strings.obStepAccessibilityBody: Needed to invert mouse scrolling and for the window switcher to respond to the keyboard.
Strings.obStepDoneBody: Vorssaint is already looking after your Mac.
Strings.obStepMenuBarBody: Pick what to show next to the icon. The preview above updates live.
Strings.obStepMenuBarNote: New: Network and Power blocks and graphs in the panel. Fine-tune it all later in Settings › Monitor.
Strings.obStepMonitorBody: The panel shows CPU, GPU and battery temperatures, hardware usage and memory pressure.
Strings.obStepOptionalBody: Turn on what you want to use now. Everything can be changed later in Settings.
Strings.obStepPanelBody: Open each block and pick exactly what shows when you click the icon.
Strings.obStepPanelNavigationBody: The panel can now show one section at a time. You can switch between Sections and List in Settings.
Strings.obStepRecordingBody: Lets the switcher show real window thumbnails instead of icons only.
Strings.obStepStatusBody: Make sure everything is ready for the features you want.
Strings.obStepWelcomeBody: A discreet menu bar utility that makes everyday macOS more practical.
Strings.obWelcomeBullet1Body: Keep the Mac awake for as long as you want, even with the lid closed.
Strings.obWelcomeBullet2Body: CPU, GPU and battery temperatures, hardware usage and memory pressure in real time.
Strings.obWelcomeBullet2Title: A clear view of the system
Strings.obWelcomeBullet3Body: Reversed mouse scrolling and a window switcher with thumbnails.
Strings.obWhatsNewFallback: This update includes the latest fixes and improvements.
Strings.ocrCaption: Select an area of the screen and the recognized text is copied, ready to paste.
Strings.ocrQRCaption: If the area has a QR code, its content is shown to copy or open.
Strings.ocrRemoveLineBreaksCaption: Removes line breaks so copied text pastes as one paragraph.
Strings.panelNavigationCaption: Shows one section at a time. Choose List to see everything in one continuous scroll.
Strings.pastePlainCaption: Pastes what you copied without colors, fonts or formatting. The original stays on the clipboard.
Strings.permissionRestartNote: macOS may ask to reopen the app after granting.
Strings.powerUnavailable: Power metrics unavailable on this Mac
Strings.preciseVolumeRollerCaption: Turns volume wheels and keys into smaller system volume steps.
Strings.preciseVolumeRollerTapFailed: Could not listen for volume keys.
Strings.scrollHorizontalCaption: Hold only the selected modifier to scroll the vertical mouse wheel horizontally. Other key combinations are unchanged.
Strings.scrollHorizontalName: Scroll sideways while holding a key
Strings.scrollTrackpadNote: The trackpad is untouched: it keeps macOS natural scrolling.
Strings.secureInputHeldFormat: %@ is holding it, so Vorssaint cannot type for you. Dismiss its password field, or quit it, to release it.
Strings.secureInputUnattributed: No running app claims it. Log out and back in to clear it.
Strings.secureInputUnidentified: The app holding it could not be identified, so Vorssaint cannot type for you.
Strings.shelfClearOnCloseCaption: Empties the shelf only when you click its close button. Automatic hiding and collapsing keep the items.
Strings.shelfCloseAfterDrop: Close after dropping into another app
Strings.shelfCloseAfterDropCaption: Closes the shelf when the destination accepts the items. The pin in the panel keeps it open.
Strings.shelfDockIslandNote: The Dynamic Island keeps the top center while it is on.
Strings.shelfDropZoneCaption: While you drag a file, the shelf appears below the menu bar icon. Whatever you drop is kept right there, in a button you shrink and open with a click that goes away once the shelf is empty.
Strings.shelfDropZoneCaptionTopCenter: While you drag a file, the shelf appears as a badge at the top center of the screen. Whatever you drop is kept right there, in a badge you open with a click that goes away once the shelf is empty.
Strings.shelfDropZoneToggle: Keep dragged files in the menu bar
Strings.shelfEdgeCaption: Drag a file toward the screen edge to peek the shelf in. Drop it there, or pull back and it retreats.
Strings.shelfEnableCaption: A floating spot to gather files, images and text, then drag them anywhere later.
Strings.shelfExclusionsCaption: Shake and the menu bar drop zone stay off for drags started in these apps. The shortcut and Open now still work.
Strings.shelfHint: Click to select. Drag out to use or right-click for more actions.
Strings.shelfRemoveAfterDropCaption: Items accepted by another app leave the shelf. Turn this off to keep a copy there. Pinned items always stay.
Strings.shelfShakeCaption: Shake the pointer quickly while holding an item to summon it near the cursor.
Strings.shelfShakeToggle: Open by shaking the mouse while dragging
Strings.shelfShortcutFinderSelection: Add the Finder selection with the shortcut
Strings.shelfShortcutFinderSelectionCapt: With Finder in front, the shortcut opens the shelf with the selected files already in it. With nothing selected, it opens as usual.
Strings.shelfStep1: Open it with the shortcut, or by shaking the mouse during a drag.
Strings.shelfStep2: Drop files, images, links or text onto it to hold them.
Strings.shelfStep3: Drag each item back out to any app when you need it.
Strings.shortcutConflictFormat: This shortcut is already used by %@.
Strings.shortcutInvalid: Use at least Control, Option or Command with a key.
Strings.shortcutNotCaptured: Nothing was captured. macOS or another app already uses that combination. Try another one.
Strings.shortcutTakeOverCaption: macOS gets the key back whenever Vorssaint is not running or this feature is off.
Strings.shortcutTakeOverOffer: macOS uses %@ for one of its own shortcuts.
Strings.shortcutUnavailable: macOS rejected this shortcut. Choose another one.
Strings.shortcutsPageCaption: Edit every global shortcut from the features installed on this Mac. Inactive shortcuts stay saved but do not run.
Strings.showCountdown: Show remaining time next to the icon
Strings.smoothScrollCaption: Turns each mouse wheel step into a short, gentle glide. The trackpad is not affected.
Strings.soundOutputSwitcherCaption: Choose outputs and use the shortcut to move to the next available one.
Strings.soundOutputSwitcherNoAvailableSe: Select at least one available output.
Strings.spacesOrderCaption: Stops macOS from rearranging Spaces by most recent use, so they stay in the order you set. Your previous setting returns when this is turned off. The Dock may restart once to apply the change.
Strings.spacesOrderName: Keep Spaces in a fixed order
Strings.sudoersFailed: Couldn’t turn on closed-lid mode. Try again.
Strings.supportIntroCoffeeButton: Support on Buy Me a Coffee
Strings.supportIntroMessage: If you would like to support development financially, Buy Me a Coffee is the one place to do it.
Strings.supportIntroStarMessage: Financial support is never expected. A star on GitHub helps more people discover Vorssaint and makes a real difference to its development.
Strings.switcherAppearanceDelayCaption: How long the shortcut must be held before the switcher appears.
Strings.switcherCurrentDisplayOnlyCaptio: Lists only windows on the display under the pointer. If that display has no windows, the switcher does not open.
Strings.switcherCurrentSpaceOnlyCaption: Lists only windows from the desktop you are on. Picking a window never moves you to another desktop.
Strings.switcherEnableCaption: Switch between apps and windows, including minimized windows and multiple windows from the same app.
Strings.switcherIconRowModeCaption: Shows one icon per app with that app’s window previews above it.
Strings.switcherInstantSelectionCaption: Moves the highlight and scroll position immediately as you browse apps and windows.
Strings.switcherMergeTabsCaption: Collapses all of an app’s windows into one entry in the switcher, instead of one entry per window.
Strings.switcherScreenPlacementCaption: Which display the switcher opens on when more than one is connected.
Strings.switcherSearchPinCaption: S starts a search and pins the switcher open, so typing no longer produces special characters when your shortcut uses ⌥, and a search starting with Q or W no longer closes the window or quits the app by mistake.
Strings.switcherShowShortcutHintsCaption: Shows the app and window shortcuts below the icons.
Strings.switcherSimpleModeCaption: Shows app icons and window titles, without previews or screen capture by the switcher.
Strings.switcherTakeOverSystemShortcutsC: Disables the matching macOS app and window shortcuts only while Vorssaint’s switcher is active. All running apps stay reachable.
Strings.switcherTreatHiddenAppsLikeMinim: Treat hidden apps like minimized windows
Strings.switcherUsageHint: Hold the shortcut to navigate; release to activate the window. Shift or ← goes back; W closes the window; Q quits the app; Esc cancels.
Strings.switcherUsageHintFormat: Hold %@ to navigate; release to activate the window. Shift or ← goes back; W closes the window; Q quits the app; Esc cancels.
Strings.switcherWindowShortcutCaption: Opens a switcher for the frontmost app’s windows. While the switcher is open, jumps between the selected app’s windows.
Strings.switcherWindowlessAppsCaption: Chooses which running apps with no window at all show up in the switcher.
Strings.uninstallerCommandBarCaption: Choose and uninstall apps in the Command Bar.
Strings.uninstallerConfirmationExpired: This confirmation is no longer valid. Review the current items and confirm again.
Strings.uninstallerEmptyNote: Nothing is removed without your confirmation.
Strings.uninstallerEnableCaption: Removes an app together with the caches, preferences, logs and leftovers it leaves behind.
Strings.uninstallerFDAHint: Turn Vorssaint on in the list. If it isn’t there, click + and pick Vorssaint from Applications. Access only applies after you reopen the app.
Strings.uninstallerFDANote: Grant Full Disk Access for a more thorough scan.
Strings.uninstallerFailedNeedsFDA: Sandboxed app data can only be moved with Full Disk Access. The administrator password does not stand in for it.
Strings.uninstallerHomebrewPackageFormat: %@ will also be removed from Homebrew.
Strings.uninstallerSelectionUnavailable: Select an app that can be removed in Finder, or choose another from the list.
Strings.uninstallerSomeFailed: Some items couldn’t be moved to the Trash.
Strings.uninstallerStep1: Drag an app onto Settings, or pick one from the list.
Strings.uninstallerStep2: Review the files found and how much space they take.
Strings.uninstallerStep3: Move what you want to the Trash. Nothing is deleted permanently.
Strings.updateInstallFailedBody: The update was downloaded but could not be applied. Download the latest version from the GitHub releases page and drag the app over the current one.
Strings.updateNeedsApplicationsBody: The app is running from a place that cannot be updated, such as the disk image or a temporary system location. Drag Vorssaint to the Applications folder, open it from there and try again.
Strings.updateShowcaseMessage: Take a quick look at the main improvements in this update.
Strings.updateShowcaseUnavailable: The video could not load right now. You can still continue.
Strings.urlCleanerEnable: Clean URLs as you copy them
Strings.urlCleanerEnableCaption: Removes tracking parameters from a link the moment it reaches the clipboard.
Strings.urlCleanerRulesCaption: A site attaches these parameters to its own share links to track where the link came from. Switched on, a name is removed when a link is cleaned; switched off, it stays. Names you add can be deleted.
